critique: The procedural generation of the spiderweb—featuring organic jitter, dashed tension strands, and a sequentially timed SVG dash-offset animation—beautifully captures the meticulous, living architecture of natural silk. However, the arbitrary placement of the sepia-toned guinea pig image and the masked background video completely disrupt the delicate ink-wash aesthetic rather than integrating into a cohesive, purposeful cyber-nature fusion.
